accepted_advisories.reason: Navigation targets are repository-defined same-origin constants; no user-controlled value is passed to Link, Navigate, or useNavigate.
Navigation targets are repository-defined same-origin constants; no user-controlled backslash or protocol-relative route reaches router navigation.
The application does not use server rendering, hydration data deserialization, or React Server Components.
The client SPA has no redirect loader/action endpoint and does not build redirect targets from request data.

claim_boundary: This is a bounded engineering risk acceptance for a controlled prototype, not a security certification or healthcare-production approval.
